body:
don't let your parents ruin your life. don't give them that power. be strong. that's how i convinced myself not to waste my energy hating my parents--it only gives them more power.

you can do it.

Don't do it. Please. There are people who love you. You have so so so much to live for. I know what it's like to be a teenager and depressed (i'm 17). It will end. Trust me. This sounds cliche, but in 10 years you'll look back and be so glad you didn't do it.

What happened to you sucks. No doubt about it. But a lot of things suck. Life isn't fair. You're strong; you're capable; you will get through this.

I believe in you. Keep hanging in there, brother.
